ModMetaData.name: ESCP - Orsimer
ModMetaData.description: The Elder Scrolls Collaboration Project Presents: Orsimer, an Elder Scrolls xenotype and faction mod featuring the Orcs of Wrothgar and Orsinium. Based on the original ESCP Orsimer by SirMashedPotato, rebuilt to run without Humanoid Alien Races.
